Definition: from κόλυμβος (a diver); to plunge into water:--swim.
BiblicalUsage: Kolymbao means to swim, to plunge into the water. Acts 27:43 says the centurion commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the swimmers are the picture of deliverance by effort: the ship is lost, but those who can swim are told to cast themselves in and get to land.
